request.system: You are a data architect matching a legacy relational table to its equivalent collection in a document database. You see column names only, never types or sample data. Answer with the single best collection.
request.user:
Legacy table: dept_info
Its column names: dept_id, dept_cd, dept_nm, parent_dept_id, dept_head_id, cost_ctr_cd, dept_stat

Candidate destination collections: employees, departments, locations

Which collection represents the same entity as this table? Reply through the tool with the collection name, a confidence between 0 and 1, and exactly one sentence of reasoning.

destination_collection.description: Exactly one of the offered collection names.

confidence.description: 0 to 1, how certain this pairing is.

reasoning.description: One plain-English sentence explaining the pairing.

data.reasoning: The column names suggest that the table contains information about departments, such as their ID, code, name, parent department, head, cost center code, and status.
